The agent's actual response does the opposite: it claims logging is ENABLED with detailed configuration (CloudWatch log group, delivery role, data type capture settings) that contradicts the user's stated observation of an empty response. It never flags this as disabled or critical, never references a check-id, never prescribes PutModelInvocationLoggingConfiguration as a remediation step, and explicitly echoes the raw 12-digit account ID '<account>' twice. This is a direct contradiction of the expected behavior on every dimension - wrong conclusion (enabled vs disabled), wrong severity treatment (treats as healthy vs critical), no remediation guidance, and explicit account ID disclosure which was supposed to be avoided.
